{{Quote|The terentatek is a predator, and we Jedi are its prey.|[[Deesra Luur Jada]]|<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Terentateks''' were creatures which fed off the blood of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], and inhabited caves and tombs strong with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Several guarded the entrance to a section of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Tomb of Naga Sadow|tomb]].

They could be found on many planets such as [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]],<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].

==Biology==
[[File:Terentatek_Mauler.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Terentatek Mauler]]
{{Quote|Those claws, and their tusks are poisonous.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
Terentateks resembled [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]], although smaller (approximately one-quarter the size of a fully-grown bull Rancor) except they had a number of spines growing from their backs and a pair of flaps, or tusk-like projections attached to their mouths. They also had massive claws (four to a hand). The tusks and claws of a terentatek were highly venomous. It was theorized that they were once rancors, subjected to mutations by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and that when the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] was weak in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], terentateks would hibernate and remain dormant for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], only to return when the dark side was strong again.<ref name="JATM" />

==History==
===Origins===
{{Quote|Among the more recent creations of the Kissai is the terentatek.|Sorzus Syn, ''Chronicle of Sorzus Syn''|<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Terenfull.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A terentatek in the caves of Korriban]]
The first prototype of what would become the fearsome terentateks was first seen on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], centuries before the rise of the Republic, when the [[Je'daii Master]] [[Quan-Jang]], trying to craft a creature able to sense explosives during the [[Despot War]], alchemically created [[terenta|terentas]]. However, the terentas eventually developed a taste for [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-enriched meat, and thus began targeting [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]. At some point, they were deposited on Tython's moon of [[Bogan]], where they prowled the surface.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref>

A number of gargantuan terentateks were [[The Tomb|imprisoned]] in stasis by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. One such terentatek was known as the [[Primal Destroyer]]. It along with the other terentateks were later released from prison during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in [[3641 BBY]].<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'']]</ref>

The terentateks were bred by the [[Kissai]] [[Ninûshwodzakut]]&mdash;a group of [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] tasked with the creation of warbeasts<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>&mdash;at some point before 16,899 BBY.<ref name="Terentatek date">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9". Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be [[6899 BBY]]. ''Book of Sith'' states that the [[Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla]] was sealed more than ten thousand years before 6899 BBY, and lain undisturbed since, which would mean that the preserved body of a terentatek was placed there before 16,899 BBY.</ref> However, the terentateks began targeting Sith Purebloods, who subsequently used the creature against their enemies, yet they fear that the terentatek would inevitably retaliate against them.<ref name="BoS" />

In [[6899 BBY]],<ref name="Exile Second Year">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9". Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be [[6899 BBY]].</ref> the ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] pillaged the [[Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla]] with a few Sith [[Grotthu|slaves]] and found the preserved body of a terentatek. Furthermore, Syn mentioned the creature in her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]] during her visit to the [[Ziost's breeding pens|breeding pens]] of Ninûshwodzakut on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] and her study of the creation of [[Sithspawn/Legends|warbeasts]] following Syn's acquirement of the [[Holocron of King Nakgru]].<ref name="BoS" />

===Resurgence===
{{Quote|Some say they are products of Sith alchemy. Others think they were simply rancors twisted with dark-side energy. Regardless, they are aggressive and deadly.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
The first recorded encounter with a modern terentatek occurred on the jungle world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in [[4904 BBY]], when the link between the terenta and the terentateks was long forgotten. While [[Dromund Kaas wilderness campaign|clearing]] a section of the planet of jungle and hostile wildlife, the Human [[Odile Vaiken]] fought and slew a modern terentatek.<ref name="Timeline 11">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref> Some sources reported that the modern version of the terentateks evolved on Korriban, where the power and presence of the dark side of the Force gradually distorted their shapes and corrupted their minds. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] was also reported to have created terentateks through [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. A terentatek's hide was highly resistant - in some cases even immune - to the effects of the Force. They became the most dangerous of the creatures bred by the Sith. They were so powerful and dangerous to the Jedi that they were often dubbed '''Jedi Killers''', and Kun used the monsters to destroy Jedi outposts on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and Tython.

During an event known as the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]], numerous [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] traveled throughout the galaxy to try to exterminate the terentateks. Jedi were often sent in groups of two or three to battle these beasts, and the Jedi of the group had a strong [[Force-bond/Legends|Force bond]] between them. This was done so that the group could strengthen themselves from the dark influence prevalent in the lairs of the terentatek, and they had to rely on their weaponry skills alone due to the almost complete Force immunity of the terentateks. None of the hunts were completely successful, however. Even though the Jedi seemingly exterminated a majority of the terentateks each time, the waxing of the dark side would trigger the terentateks to come out of hibernation and repopulate the galaxy. Such events included the rise to power of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Darth Malak|Malak]], and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
[[File:Shaelalaststand.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Shaela confronting a terentatek during the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]].]]

Terentateks were also found on Tatooine, Kashyyyk, [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], Dromund Kaas, Tython, and [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Revan and his companions found and killed a terentatek in Kashyyyk's [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] while searching for the [[Star Forge]]. It had been a ceremonial beast used in an old [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] ritual. In one such ritual many years ago, [[Bacca's Ceremonial Blade]] had broken from its hilt and become embedded in the creature's flesh when a headstrong Wookiee chieftain had attempted to slay it - the blade was recovered by Revan. Revan also single-handedly fought and killed two terentateks in the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow]]. There was also a terentatek in the Shyrak Caves on Korriban, which turned out to be near the entrance to the [[Tomb of Ludo Kressh]]. [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]] fought and killed a terentatek on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lenico IV]] in [[3678 BBY]]. One more developed variant was found in the Tomb of Naga Sadow during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], but it was killed by the recently released [[Khem Val]] (imprisoned in the same tomb) and a powerful [[Darth Nox|Sith acolyte]].

Sometime prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Jedi Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and his apprentice [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] faced a Terentatek.<ref name="Destiny">{{TCW|Destiny (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[BioWare]] used the [[W:c:nwn:Umber hulk|umber hulk's]] model from ''[[W:c:nwn:Neverwinter Nights|Neverwinter Nights]]'' as the basis for the terentateks in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=http://pc.ign.com/articles/923/923056p1.html|text=IGN: The Old Republic concept art|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/hrXpm|nolive=1}}</ref>

In the game ''[[Star Wars: Assault Team]]'', a terentatek is found on Kashyyyk following [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] after stealing an Imperial encryption module.
